notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Revolutionist.
When Dockside Extortionist and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
